notes.title: UPDATE #7 - Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello fellow nomads! 

Today we uploaded a new build that fixes two minor issues on dialogues, a major issue with the russian translation, and the Map rendering issue on Mac.

Enjoy!

notes.title: UPDATE #6 - Trading cards and new update
notes.notes:
We finally have Trading Cards in ICY: Frostbite Edition! Sincere thanks to the many people who supported the game and made this possible.

We also updated the game in order to fix some minor issues.

Here's a complete changelog for this update:

    Tradings Cards are now available,
    4k resolution is now supported (Thanks to fizfix for his help on this matter),
    Some rarely occuring UI glitches have been fixed,
    A rare bug preventing to access some dialogues in the late-game has been fixed.


Thanks again for your support!

notes.title: UPDATE #5 RUSSIAN LANGUAGE AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
Many of you asked for it, and now the Russian language is available! The translation was made by Viktor "viklvikl" Lashmanov, he did an awesome job translating the massive amount of text included in the game.

This patch also addresses some minor issues and a rare blocking bug that forced some people to use the old legacy version of the game.

Let us know what you think about the Russian localization, we hope that it will allow many more people to fully enjoy our game!

notes.title: UPDATE #4 Changelog
notes.notes:
Here's another update for ICY! We followed the feedbacks we gathered on the forum and added some features:


    Fix: player can now buy Resources and Recipes when inventory is full.
    Crafting: added new recipes for new armors, in order to improve their variety.
    Writing: fixed some grammar issues
UI: now player can navigate through the map with WASD.
UI: reduced tooltip delay
UI: added quantity for items in crafting panel


More features will come with future updates!

notes.title: UPDATE #3 - Version 1.1.6445.27100 - Changelog
notes.notes:
A third update is now live! Here's the changelog:

 UI: fixed resource tooltips in inventory screen
 Script: fixed an issue allowing the player to skip part of the main plot in certain rare scenarios.
 Script: fixed an issue on some events not consuming ammo.
 Script: fixed a minor typo.
 Script: fixed a lynx-related event consuming a wrong resource.
 Tutorial: slightly improved tutorial's clarity in a couple lines.

notes.title: Official group & UPDATE #2 - Version 1.1.6437.29596 - Changelog
notes.notes:
Another day, another patch! Some more fixes for the game!

But there's something else! We opened a Facebook group, to have a direct contact with all fans and followers, hoping to gather detailed feedbacks, suggestions, and have some fun!

Link: https://www.facebook.com/groups/peoplefromthevoid/

We just opened it, but feel free to come and join us!

Patch Changelog:

 Fixed an issue with one of Morgan's endings, preventing to access to the correct ending.
 Traders are now selling the Incendiary Grenade schematic as it was meant to be.
 Slightly fixed the last tutorial screen.
 The Sniper Rifle crafting recipe is now available. 
 Added the Silenced Sniper Rifle crafting recipe.
 Fixed the RPG cost in bullets.
 Fixed the RPG having no actions.
 Fixed two personal dialogues of Janeve to be coeherent with what happens in the story. 
 UI: added an alert on player avatar when there are skill points available to be assigned.
 UI: bullet cost field size fixed in tooltip.
 UI: in fight, player can skip animations in enemy's turn.
 UI: in fight, player can select only 4 icons together.
 UI: player can abort the fight, causing immediate game over.
